I am a biomedical data scientist experienced in building products and solutions for drug discovery. With expertise in data science and the life sciences, I collaborate across teams to deliver workflows that streamline drug development. My projects have incorporated large language models (LLMs) for scientific knowledge applications, scalable data pipelines for genomic data integration, AI/ML techniques to generate insights from large-scale bioinformatics data, and user-focused data visualization and communication.
